799:   /**
800:    * Stream one assistant turn. `base` is the history sent to the model; when
801:    * `userTurn` is given it is appended to that history, otherwise the last
802:    * message of `base` is the turn being re-answered. The new assistant turn is
803:    * parented to `assistantParentId`, which is how branches stay linked.
804:    */
805:   const runTurn = useCallback(
806:     async (
807:       base: ChatMessage[],
808:       userTurn: ChatMessage | null,
809:       assistantParentId: string,
810:     ) => {
811:       if (streaming) {
812:         return;
813:       }
814: 
815:       const history: ChatMessage[] = userTurn ? [...base, userTurn] : base;
816: 
817:       const assistantId = newTurnId();
818:       const assistantIndex = history.length;
819:       setMessages([
820:         ...history,
821:         { role: "assistant", id: assistantId, parentId: assistantParentId, content: "", parts: [] },
822:       ]);
823:       setStreaming(true);
824:       setThinkingPhase("health_check");
825:       setOfflineReply(false);
826: 
827:       const controller = new AbortController();
828:       abortRef.current = controller;
829: 
830:       let content = "";
831:       let parts: ChatPart[] = [];
832:       let steps: RunStep[] = [];
833:       let failure: StudioError | null = null;
834:       let terminal = false;
835:       let stopped = false;
836: 
837:       // Prose is appended to the open text part; a surface opens a new one, so
838:       // the transcript keeps the agent's order instead of gathering all prose
839:       // above all cards.
840:       const appendText = (text: string) => {
841:         if (!text) {
842:           return;
843:         }
844:         content += text;
845:         const last = parts[parts.length - 1];
846:         parts =
847:           last?.kind === "text"
848:             ? [...parts.slice(0, -1), { kind: "text", text: last.text + text }]
849:             : [...parts, { kind: "text", text }];
850:       };
851: 
852:       // The turn owns its own timeline, so a finished run stays inspectable and
853:       // the next turn starts from nothing without a reset elsewhere.
854:       const publish = () => {
855:         setMessages((prev) => {
856:           if (prev.length <= assistantIndex) {
857:             return prev;
858:           }
859:           const next = [...prev];
860:           const retryText = userTurn?.content ?? base[base.length - 1]?.content ?? "";
861:           next[assistantIndex] = {
862:             role: "assistant",
863:             id: assistantId,
864:             parentId: assistantParentId,
865:             content,
866:             parts: [...parts],
867:             ...(failure ? { error: failure, retryText } : {}),
868:             ...(stopped ? { stopped: true, retryText } : {}),
869:             ...(steps.length ? { tools: [...steps] } : {}),
870:           };
871:           return next;
872:         });
873:       };
874: 
875:       const handleEvent = (event: RawSseEvent) => {
876:         switch (event.event) {
877:           case "status": {
878:             const phase = String(event.data.phase ?? "");
879:             setThinkingPhase(phase);
880:             if (phase === "offline") {
881:               setOfflineReply(true);
882:             }
883:             break;
884:           }
885:           case "delta": {
886:             appendText(String(event.data.text ?? ""));
887:             publish();
888:             break;
889:           }
890:           case "ui": {
891:             // Validate again on arrival: the connection is local but the
892:             // renderer must never trust a shape it has not checked.
893:             const parsed = parseUiSpec(event.data.spec, catalogManifest());
894:             if (parsed.ok) {
895:               parts = [
896:                 ...parts,
897:                 { kind: "ui", id: String(event.data.id ?? `ui-${parts.length}`), node: parsed.node },
898:               ];
899:               publish();
900:             }
901:             break;
902:           }
903:           case "tool":
904:             steps = applyToolEvent(
905:               steps,
906:               {
907:                 name: String(event.data.name ?? ""),
908:                 status: String(event.data.status ?? ""),
909:                 preview: event.data.preview ? String(event.data.preview) : undefined,
910:               },
911:               Date.now(),
912:             );
913:             publish();
914:             break;
915:           case "message": {
916:             terminal = true;
917:             content = String(event.data.content ?? content);
918:             const hasSurfaces = parts.some((part) => part.kind === "ui");
919:             if (!hasSurfaces) {
920:               parts = content ? [{ kind: "text", text: content }] : [];
921:             }
922:             publish();
923:             break;
924:           }
925:           case "conversation": {
926:             const id = String(event.data.id ?? "");
927:             if (id) {
928:               setConversationId(id);
929:             }
930:             break;
931:           }
932:           case "memory": {
933:             const observation = event.data.observation as Observation | undefined;
934:             if (observation?.id) {
935:               setMemory((prev) =>
936:                 prev.some((item) => item.id === observation.id)
937:                   ? prev.map((item) => (item.id === observation.id ? observation : item))
938:                   : [...prev, observation],
939:               );
940:             }
941:             break;
942:           }
943:           case "canvas_dirty":
944:             void refreshCanvas();
945:             break;
946:           case "connector": {
947:             if (String(event.data.status ?? "") === "error") {
948:               const reason = String(event.data.error ?? "The connector could not be added.");
949:               setMessages((prev) => [
950:                 ...prev,
951:                 { role: "notice", id: newTurnId(), parentId: null, content: `Connector failed: ${reason}` },
952:               ]);
953:             } else {
954:               setConnectorSuggestions((prev) => {
955:                 const id = String(event.data?.preset ?? event.data?.name ?? "");
956:                 if (!id || prev.includes(id)) {
957:                   return prev;
958:                 }
959:                 return [...prev, id];
960:               });
961:             }
962:             void refreshConnectors();
963:             break;
964:           }
965:           case "error": {
966:             terminal = true;
967:             failure = readStudioError(event.data.error);
968:             publish();
969:             break;
970:           }
971:           default:
972:             break;
973:         }
974:       };
975: 
976:       try {
977:         await streamChat(
978:           {
979:             base_url: settings.base_url,
980:             api_key: settings.api_key,
981:             model: settings.model_name,
982:             mcp_url: settings.mcp_url,
983:             messages: history,
984:             brief,
985:             ui_catalog: catalogManifest(),
986:             conversation_id: conversationId,
987:           },
988:           handleEvent,
989:           controller.signal,
990:         );
991:       } catch (error) {
992:         const aborted = (error as Error).name === "AbortError";
993:         if (aborted) {
994:           // An abort is the user's own doing, so it is not a failure — but it is
995:           // still a fact about the turn. Keep what arrived, stop any tool that
996:           // was mid-flight, and leave the turn in place so the transcript says
997:           // what happened instead of silently losing the question.
998:           stopped = true;
999:           steps = steps.map((step) =>
1000:             step.status === "running"
1001:               ? {
1002:                   ...step,
1003:                   status: "stopped",
1004:                   preview: step.preview ?? "Stopped before it returned.",
1005:                   endedAt: Date.now(),
1006:                 }
1007:               : step,
1008:           );
1009:           publish();
1010:         } else {
1011:           terminal = true;
1012:           failure = asStudioError(error);
1013:           publish();
1014:         }
1015:       } finally {
1016:         if (!terminal && !failure && !stopped) {
1017:           // The stream ended without a message or an error: something failed
1018:           // silently, and the user must still be told.
1019:           failure = {
1020:             code: "internal",
1021:             message: "The assistant stopped before answering.",
1022:             suggestion: "Try again — your question is still here.",
1023:             retryable: true,
1024:           };
1025:           publish();
1026:         }
1027:         setStreaming(false);
1028:         setThinkingPhase(null);
1029:         abortRef.current = null;
1030:       }
1031:     },
1032:     [streaming, settings, brief, conversationId, refreshCanvas, refreshConnectors],
1033:   );

1035:   const sendMessage = useCallback(
1036:     async (
1037:       text: string,
1038:       attachments: ChatAttachment[] = [],
1039:       options: { from?: string } = {},
1040:     ) => {
1041:       const trimmed = text.trim();
1042:       if ((!trimmed && !attachments.length) || streaming) {
1043:         return;
1044:       }
1045: 
1046:       // A re-ask replaces the turn it starts from: the old question and the
1047:       // answer it got are the same turn, and keeping both would read as a
1048:       // conversation the reader never had.
1049:       const cut = options.from
1050:         ? messages.findIndex((message) => message.id === options.from)
1051:         : -1;
1052:       const replaced = cut >= 0 ? messages.slice(0, cut) : messages;
1053:
